stages.title: Source cleaning
stages.input: Raw sources exactly as they arrived
stages.output: The same sources, without the rows that evidence nothing

rules.rule: Discard references with a median price below 0.5 USD
rules.reason: Zero-amount lines are samples, warranties or charges billed apart. Holding cost derives from the value of the part, so at zero value the economic order quantity diverges and comparing offers stops meaning anything

rules.rule: Discard references with fewer than 8 events in the window
rules.reason: Two thirds of the source references are ordered once in several years. They are real and they are the tail of the catalogue, but with a single event there is nothing to project

rules.rule: Discard part-and-plant series with fewer than 3 events
rules.reason: A reference active in one complex can appear once loose in the other, and that series is not projectable either even though the part is
Order lines kept for the catalogue

stages.title: Relational dataset
stages.output: Related, validated tables by part, city and supplier

stages.title: Demand patterns
stages.output: One pattern label and one confidence score per series

stages.title: Demand forecast
stages.input: 18 features derived from each series and its part
stages.output: A monthly demand forecast and a reorder point per series
